europe_now.title: Spanish Prime Minister Addresses Ceuta Migrant Crisis
europe_now.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez stated there is no solid proof that Morocco planned the recent migrant rush at the Ceuta border. Meanwhile, thousands of protesters have marched across Spain following the escalating crisis.

sources.headline: 🔴 No 'solid proof' Morocco planned Ceuta migrant rush, says Spanish PM Sanchez
Thousands of protesters march in Spain over Ceuta migrant crisis

europe_now.title: Norway Enforces Russian Ship Seizure
europe_now.summary: Norway has seized a Russian ship to enforce a multibillion-dollar Ukrainian compensation claim resulting from arbitration. The action highlights ongoing legal and diplomatic measures related to regional conflicts.

sources.headline: Norway seizes Russian ship to enforce $4.22 billion Ukrainian compensation claim

top_stories.title: France and United Kingdom Diplomatic Engagement
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron traveled to Britain to view the Bayeux Tapestry in London. He is holding his first talks with UK representatives to discuss bilateral ties and regional defense cooperation.
